logos.attribution: Mapam; Shmuel Katz (poster designer); Central Zionist Archives KRA/3225. Crop from a dated official campaign publication, not a recreated emblem.
logos.inUseEvidence: Crop from a party-issued 1959 campaign poster, CZA KRA/3225. Archive caption identifies Mapam, 1959, designer Shmuel Katz; printed issuer line identifies Mapam (Haifa). The distinctive white מ in an orange-red circle is preserved without redrawing or recolouring. Year-level campaign date only; the 22 November 1959 accession stamp is NOT an in-use date. Not hosted: the existing build requires a complete ISO campaign-use date; the archive supplies only the year. No day is inferred from its accession stamp.
